uzbekistan.local.json is an offline export captured from the existing SQLite demo before the intelligence migration on 2026-09-06. It contains 16 discovered clubs, 27 player stubs, 3 enriched profiles and 5 performance rows. Dates are revived explicitly in tests and the reference scoring date is fixed. No test fetches Transfermarkt. Internal IDs are retained to preserve real roster relationships; no notes, credentials, cookies or secrets are included.
